descByPlatform.chatgpt: Medium Shot Cultural Heritage Portrait for GUADALAJARA SON AW26 mariachi heritage drop. Subject: a Mexican mariachi musician 38, of Jaliscan lineage, thick black moustache curled to fine points, deep dark eyes, warm tan skin; Subsurface Scattering · Visible Pores · Fine Micro-Textures · natural capillary flush across cheekbones and nose-bridge in dusk warmth. Wardrobe: full traje de charro de gala — a charro-black #141418 fine-wool charro suit with rows of silver-conchos #C4C6CA silver botonadura button-set running down the bolero jacket and down the outside seam of the trousers, silver-embroidered águila on the back of the jacket, a wide botonadura-matching concho belt, a crisp white pecherón ruffled shirt, a red silk moño lavallière bow-tie, a wide-brimmed sombrero-charcoal #2E2E34 felt sombrero de charro with galoneado silver-wire ala trim, silver-tipped ankle boots, cradling a Paracho-built vihuela guitar with a mother-of-pearl rosette. Setting: Plaza de los Mariachis at dusk, cobblestone paving, a colonial cathedral silhouette, plaza-amber-lights #E8B060 warm string bulbs overhead in shallow focus. Composition: Rule of Thirds face 44% x 40% y, hero vertical, Eye-Level 0°, body slightly 3/4, one hand resting on vihuela neck, gaze steady and soulful. Camera: Sony A7R V · 85mm f/1.8 · 1/160s · ISO 400. Lighting: Dusk Plaza Warm Ambient Side Lighting + Rim Lighting — string-light camera-right 60° elevation 2.5m (key warm), 4×4ft gold bounce camera-left 1.5m (fill on face), 1×3ft strip rim camera-back 30° grazing sombrero galoneado and concho botonadura (rim highlighting silver wire), 4×4ft black flag below left to anchor suit shadow. Material physics: charro fine-wool twill dense drape, silver botonadura-concho hand-chased specular, wool-felt sombrero crushable nap, silk pecherón ruffle crisp fold, vihuela cedar-top satin. Color grade: Kodak Portra 400 emulation grain 6 +0.2 EV. Palette: charro-black 26%, silver-conchos 18%, sombrero-charcoal 18%, plaza-amber-lights 18%, skin-warm 20%. References: Graciela Iturbide archive, Vogue México heritage, National Geographic Jalisco. Exclude: harsh flash, plastic skin, AI hallucination artifacts, cropped extremities, muddy shadows.
